I am an old woman, and I have farmed this land for many years. This maize plot is small, only a little less than half a hectare, and I intercrop it with cowpea and sometimes sorghum like my mother taught me. I will buy some NPK if the agro-dealer in town has the subsidized bag, but money is tight, so I cannot put as much as the extension people say. My children help me weed, and I will hire two or three young men for the hard clearing work because my back is not strong anymore.
